name.en: HG 1/144 ZAKU Ⅱ F TYPE CHUBS & KALE + ZAKUⅡ (UNIDENTIFIED TYPE) SOLARI CUSTOM PARTS SET (RFV)

en: ■ ―　―　―　―　―　―　―　―　―　―　― 　 Dedicated to the Red Wolves 　 ―　―　―　―　―　―　―　―　―　―　― 　 From "MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM: REQUIEM FOR VENGEANCE", which is distributed exclusively on Netflix, Red Wolf Squad's "Zaku II. F-type Chubbs machine" and "Zaku II. F-type Cale machine" are commercialized as a set of two. In addition, a set of parts that can reproduce the "unidentified Zaku II. Solari machine" using the separately sold "Zaku II. F type Solari machine" is included. The details of the MS drawn in full CG are densely reproduced on a 1/144 scale. 　 ● Red Wolf Squad's Zaku II. Precisely reproduced the F type. 　　The characteristic precise details and shapes applied to the whole body are reproduced with a part composition unique to plastic models. 　　* Chubbs machines need to be painted on the head and waist. 　　* The cale machine needs to paint the hand parts, legs, and long rifles. 　　* The posted image has been weathered and painted. 　 By sliding the ribs on the back of the head, the position of the mono eye can be adjusted. 　　The leg movement pipe follows the movement of the foot by providing a movable axis at the joint. 　 The shoulder armor with the spikes of the Chubs machine is reproduced with new parts. 　　 ● Various weapons are included.　 　　In addition to the Zaku Machine Gun and Heat Hawk, the Zaku Bazooka and Long Rifle are newly included. 　　The Heat Hawk and Zaku Machine Gun can be suspended on the back via joint parts. 　 The Chubbs plane comes with a missile pod. 　 ● Unidentified type Zaku II. Various parts to reproduce the Solari machine are included. 　　Using "HG 1/144 ZAKUⅡ F TYPE　SOLARI (RFV)" (sold separately as a general over-the-counter item), 　　Reproduce the unidentified Zaku II that Solari boarded in the second half of the play. Various parts are included to reproduce the locally assembled Zaku II. 　　* Unidentified type Zaku II. In order to reproduce the Solari machine, the attached parts of this product are unassembled 　　Incorporate it into "HG 1/144 ZAKUⅡ F TYPE　SOLARI (RFV)" (general over-the-counter items sold separately).　 　　* Adhesive is required for some assembly. 　　* Unidentified type Zaku II. In order to reproduce the Solari machine, it is necessary to paint. 　　* The posted image has been weathered and painted. 　 The head mono-eye cover is newly reproduced. 　　As additional armor centered on the upper body, the tracks of the Magella Attack have been added, and reinforcements are attached to the toes. 　　Equipped with missile pods on both forearms and legs. 　　The net on the left shoulder is reproduced with decorative parts. 　　 It is equipped with a double armored shield on the right shoulder for an anti-beam rifle. Equipped with a missile pod inside the shield. 　 ● Comes with waterslide decals 　　Includes Red Wolf squad insignia and waterslide decals including numbering. 　 Armaments: Zaku Machine Gun ×2 / Zaku Bazooka ×2 / Long Rifle ×1 / Heat Hawk ×2 / Missile Pod ×2 Accessories: Unidentified type Zaku II. A set of parts for reproducing the Solari machine 　 －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 　　 * In order to reproduce the Zaku II F Chubs machine, it is necessary to paint the head and waist. * In order to reproduce the Zaku II F type Cale machine, it is necessary to paint the hand parts, legs, and long rifle. 　　　　　　 －－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 　　 * Unidentified type Zaku II. Some of the parts that reproduce the Solari machine require plastic model adhesive (sold separately). * Unidentified type Zaku II.
